description: Builds a link that opens the Vargov®Design 3D configurator on a composition with the plan dimensions and the room ceiling height already filled in. Only codes that open with a full calculation are accepted (360 of 605; others return an error with the product page). lengthMm → the "Length" field of the plan, widthMm → the "Width" field, both integer millimetres, at least 300 (the plan is the zone the composition is laid out in, not a product size); heightMm → height of the cloud of elements (optional); ceilingMm → room ceiling height (optional, default 2700 in the configurator; it goes into the IFC4 file and AR); lang → interface language (ru opens configurator.vargov.ru, other languages vargov.design); openOnFormStep → open scrolled to the "Composition form" step. The visitor then picks element sizes, colours and the form; the configurator's "Share" button returns a link that reopens that exact calculation.

ceilingMm.description: Room ceiling height, integer mm (optional; configurator default 2700)

heightMm.description: Height of the cloud of elements, integer mm (optional)

lang.description: ru en de it fr es vi ar; default en

openOnFormStep.description: true: add step=form to open scrolled to the form step

name: build_configurator_link
title: Configurator link with room dimensions
